papers.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
papers.summary: When large language models write neural network weights without gradient-based training, they tend to design sparse table or associative-memory models that outperform same-sized Transformers with far fewer parameters and faster GPU inference, though pretrained LLMs remain more accurate.
papers.summary_zh: 研究LLM不经梯度训练直接编写神经网络权重，发现其倾向设计稀疏查找表式模型，参数更少、推理更快，性能优于同规模Transformer。

papers.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
papers.summary: Branching Transformer blocks into parallel parameterized branches, combined with shared KV caching, improves language model quality and inference efficiency compared with standard sequential Transformers.
papers.summary_zh: 将Transformer块拆分为并行参数化分支并共享KV缓存，相比标准顺序Transformer提升了语言模型质量与推理效率。

papers.title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
papers.summary: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must
papers.summary_zh: 为仅提供API接口的冻结多模态大模型引入接触力信息，使其能零样本控制机器人完成依赖接触力的操作任务。

papers.title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
papers.summary: AURA 2.0 is a streaming video large language model that can initiate conversations, call tools, and perform interactive visual grounding, with long-horizon memory and a three-stage training scheme for improved streaming interaction.
papers.summary_zh: 提出流式视频大模型AURA 2.0，可主动发起对话、调用工具并进行交互式视觉定位，具备长时记忆与三阶段训练方案。

papers.title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
papers.summary: A comprehensive benchmark evaluates time-series classification methods on a large clinical breath dataset under realistic temporal splits, showing that sensor drift lowers performance and recurrent models are most consistent across diseases.
papers.summary_zh: 构建呼气电子鼻时间序列分类基准Breath-Dx，发现传感器漂移会降低性能，循环模型在各疾病上表现最稳定。

papers.title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.summary: Continual recursive self-improvement lets harness optimizers reuse and revise prior edits across changing benchmarks or policy models by storing rationales, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation contexts in a self-improvement memory, improving final scores over continuation baselines.
papers.summary_zh: 提出自我改进记忆，存储修改理由、预测与观察结果及评测上下文，使优化器跨基准复用并修订历史编辑，提升最终得分。

papers.title: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
papers.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregre
papers.summary_zh: 提出FastFrames系列快速自回归视频扩散模型，将生成延迟降至可支持流畅交互的水平。

papers.title: TCP4D: A Unified Tool-Center-Point Tracking and Generation Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: Robot manipulation videos provide a rich visual experience, yet recovering robot action and gripper-state annotations from RGB observations still remains challenging. Using the embodiment-agnostic tool-center-point (TCP) pose as the action space, we present TCP4D, a unified model in which a shared 4
papers.summary_zh: 提出TCP4D统一模型，以工具中心点（TCP）位姿为动作空间，同时完成机器人操作视频的动作与夹爪状态恢复及视频生成。

papers.title: Heave-Ho: Decentralized Long-Horizon Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
papers.summary: A decentralized framework enables teams of humanoids to coordinate whole-body loco-manipulation over long horizons using low-level multi-agent post-training and a high-level vision-language planner with speech-based leader-follower synchronization.
papers.summary_zh: 提出去中心化框架Heave-Ho，让多台人形机器人借助多智能体后训练与视觉语言规划器，通过语音协同完成长时程全身移动操作。

papers.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
papers.summary: VideoNexus separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning, using perception sub-agents to return compact temporally grounded evidence and achieving higher accuracy at lower cost on long-video benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 提出VideoNexus，将细粒度视频感知与证据驱动的推理规划分离，感知子智能体返回紧凑的时序定位证据，在长视频基准上更准确、成本更低。

papers.title: π^4: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
papers.summary: This unified foundation model enables the recovery of dense geometry, camera poses, and object tracking from diverse, uncalibrated observations in 4D scenes using a shared geometry and motion branch architecture.
papers.summary_zh: 提出4D场景几何与运动基础模型π^4，可从多样未标定观测中恢复稠密几何、相机位姿并跟踪物体。

papers.title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
papers.summary: RepoFactory converts real repositories into verifiable coding environments and optimizes them via an Environment Evolution Loop using proxy feedback, enabling trained coding agents to achieve strong gains on long-horizon coding and agentic benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: 提出RepoFactory，将真实代码仓库转化为可验证的编码训练环境，并通过环境演化循环优化环境，训练出的编码智能体在长时程基准上显著提升。

papers.title: FMT: Lossless Image Compression in a Fixed Number of Parallel Steps
papers.summary: The Fixed-step Multiscale Tree (FMT) format achieves highly efficient, fixed-time decoding of images by utilizing a coarse-to-fine tree structure and parallel GPU prediction mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh: 提出固定步数多尺度树（FMT）无损图像压缩格式，借助由粗到细的树结构与并行GPU预测，实现固定时间的高效解码。

papers.title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
papers.summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable laten
papers.summary_zh: 提出医学图像理解模型MedJev，让视觉语言模型直接输出答案而非生成冗长推理文本，从而降低推理延迟、提升效率。

papers.title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
papers.summary: CADMAGEDDON is an open-source agent that reconstructs editable CAD from meshes locally on single-GPU systems and laptops, using a mid-sized Qwen model and geometric tools to outperform prior systems.
papers.summary_zh: 提出开源智能体CADMAGEDDON，可在单GPU或笔记本上基于中等规模Qwen模型与几何工具，从网格本地重建可编辑CAD模型。

papers.title: MPEG-Diffusion: Mixed-Resolution Video Generation
papers.summary: MPEG-Diffusion reduces the computational cost of video diffusion transformers by generating only a self-selected high-resolution region with dual-resolution attention and a mixed-resolution decoder, achieving faster denoising without quality loss.
papers.summary_zh: 提出MPEG-Diffusion，仅对自选的高分辨率区域进行生成，并采用双分辨率注意力与混合分辨率解码器，在不损失质量下加速视频扩散Transformer。

papers.title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
papers.summary: On-policy distillation can improve or degrade language-model agent interaction across domains, and selectively retaining teacher-preferred positions mitigates negative transfer at a cost to source-domain learning.
papers.summary_zh: 研究同策略蒸馏对LLM智能体ReAct模式的影响，发现其可能改善或损害跨领域交互，选择性保留教师偏好的位置可缓解负迁移。

papers.title: Energy-Based Reasoners: Your Recurrent Reasoner Should Be an Energy-Based Model
papers.summary: Energy-Based Reasoners guide looped latent reasoning by learning an energy function whose gradient refines states and signals when to stop, with exploration-based training improving performance and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh: 提出能量基推理器，学习能量函数引导循环潜在推理，其梯度用于精炼状态并决定何时停止，配合探索式训练提升性能与效率。
